note: Rewritten from Holmgren 1913, Termitenstudien 4, p. 220—221; the original is in German. The descriptions of the alate and the worker are quoted from Desneux (originally in French), while the soldier is Holmgren's own. The French OCR has many letter errors (pubeseent=pubescent, artieles=articles, eötes=côtés, ecliancre=échancré, Longeur=Longueur, milk=mill.), which have been read correctly from the context, the measurement values being reproduced unchanged. The soldier measurements are given in four lines in the original (Kopf mit Kiefern 2,85 / ohne 2,09 / Kopfbreite 1,82 / Breite des Pronotums 1,14), and have been matched to the full Chinese terms. The material following it in the bundle is the key to the genus Eurytermes and E. Assmuthi, which were not used.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, mandibles brown; body straw yellow to pale rusty yellow. Head with a few setae; posterior margin of the abdominal tergites with short setae. Head wide, rounded-square, distinctly narrowed anteriorly, slightly longer than wide. Fontanelle small, situated slightly behind the middle of the head. Postclypeus short and wide, flat. Labrum rounded-lingulate. Mandibles strongly curved, pointed, wide, with the typical teeth. Antennae long, 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal. Postmentum plano-convex. Anterior lobe of the pronotum large, erect, triangular, distinctly notched in the middle of its anterior margin. Measurements (mm): body length 7—7.6; head length with mandibles 2.85; head length without mandibles 2.09; head width 1.82; pronotum width 1.14.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale greyish brown, rounded, clypeal piece strongly projecting. Antennae shorter than in the soldier, 15-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior lobe rather large, erect and raised. Abdomen swollen, dark grey from the gut contents. Body length 5—6 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dorsum blackish brown, rather strongly hairy, venter pale. Head oval, narrowed anteriorly into a triangle, its upper surface nearly flat. Fontanelle present but very small. Compound eyes rather small and projecting, circular; ocelli oval, their distance from the compound eye less than their own length. Antennae 16-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal and slender, longer than segment 4. Clypeal piece slightly paler than the frons, its projection inconspicuous. The first two mandibular teeth subequal. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head including the compound eyes, slightly narrowed posteriorly, anterior margin straight, sides more or less rounded, posterior margin with a rather wide notch. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum notched, the angles narrowed. Wings rather large, slightly yellowish brown; costa and radius thick and very close together; media nearly straight, closer to the cubitus than to the radius, reaching the wing apex, with 1 branch or unbranched; several oblique veins between media and radius; cubitus long, with about 11 branches to the posterior margin. Body length 7—7.5 mm; forewing (excluding the scale) 13.6 x 3.9 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Sarawak (collected by Hose). Plate VIII, Fig. 14 shows the soldier.
